scope: Complete listed HBQ helpers and CBE crew/rear helpers; CortexVehicles dismount caller selectively read. Not whole-HBQ parity.

findings.source: GetOut callback waits0.5s then force-seats assigned operating crew; initial guard checks assignment, not actual renewed boarding permission.
findings.current: CBE own combat exits examined are passenger exits and explicitly unassign actors. They do not provide an operating-crew recall episode. DrivingCrewBoarding observes actual GET IN only, with original60s and12s motion limits. DrivingCrewStep replaces dead drivers with finite native seat actions and original-goal acknowledgement; it is not outside-crew recall.
findings.remaining: Automatic physical operating-crew recall remains unimplemented. Need a distinguishable current crew-task authority or explicit owner order; do not remove the actual GET IN condition or force-seat from assignment. No new module introduced merely to hide this autonomous gap.

findings.source: HBQ checks rear-sector vehicle/person proximity and six low solid rays.
findings.current: CBE independently evaluates full projected actor hulls and two-second overlap intervals, static support/deck, supported destination and straight/turning solid rays. DrivingRearPlan allows at most two observations. Angular velocity is radians/s clockwise per native documentation; current yaw conversion and clockwise rotation equations are consistent. No sign correction warranted.
findings.limits: Discrete samples do not establish continuous swept clearance. Unknown future steering and acceleration remain unknown. Up to64 actors and109 rays for a long turning observation is a static upper bound, not measured cost or compliance with5%/10% budget. No tuning changed without physical evidence.

findings.source: Collision HandleDamage suppression and timed allowDamage protection are distinct from physical navigation.
findings.current: CBE has no general collision-damage suppression; rejecting teleport/recreate does not implement this feature. Existing exact hitpoint monitoring only interrupts recovery on damage.
findings.remaining: Do not claim damage-policy parity. Broad invulnerability and overlapping independent restore timers remain rejected; any selected collision filter needs event-category and coexistence validation.

validation: No production edit, no repeated full build. Focused existing crew and reference-boundary checks only. Physical validation remains paused. No percentage or acceptance credit.
